description: AT-6 Texan of the type used by the Escuela de Aviación Militar in the 1940s, mounted in flying attitude on a 12-15 m pedestal in the centre of the roundabout since 1970; a 2014 plan to add a Tucano, OV-10, Mirage 50EV and F-16 around it is not confirmed to have happened. Serial not recorded. Photographed 2010, 2013 and 2018 (Commons/blogs).
museum_name: Redoma El Avión AT-6 Texan Monument, Maracay
